boundary_criteria: latency SLA, configured error budget, complete load delivery and sustained validation; not a proof of hardware saturation
notes: No automatic request retries; expected arrival times never shift to hide latency.
Latency is HTTP request start through usable response; IM delivery and retrieval are separate end-to-end samples.
In-flight limits, skipped arrivals, fixture exhaustion and missing samples cannot establish a service upper bound.
Resource ps CPU/RSS samples are local observations; remote backend and PostgreSQL lock/connection monitoring require separate telemetry.
Published records and completed trades accumulate; failed trade fixtures are quarantined rather than silently reused.
Single publish reuses a setup-uploaded image and measures only POST /products; mixed publish measures the full multipart upload and publish flow.

stages.completion_scope: legacy completion fields track measured-start cohort; successful_response fields include warmup carry-in responses completed during measurement
